race_name: L'Étape Tabasco by Tour de France

top_categories.workout_context: At mile 60 of 83, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 83 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
L'Étape Tabasco by Tour de France's flat tropical road course rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic L'Étape Tabasco by Tour de France's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
The aerobic base that lets you ride flat tropical road course at tempo for 83 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
When someone attacks on flat tropical road course, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of L'Étape Tabasco by Tour de France. Train it until it feels boring.

Road-specific control matters at L'Étape Tabasco by Tour de France. Practice on flat tropical road course: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 83 miles.
At L'Étape Tabasco by Tour de France, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 83 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what L'Étape Tabasco by Tour de France's flat tropical road course actually does to you.
2-minute all-out efforts on flat tropical road course. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.

race_overlay.heat: September in Villahermosa, Tabasco, Mexico — The organizer presents a lowland route through tropical vegetation, rivers, mangroves, and Gulf-influenced roads. September heat and humidity are central demands; use the final forecast for storms and wind. Begin heat acclimatization 10–14 days before L'Étape Tabasco by Tour de France — 20–30min sauna sessions or midday rides in full kit. Pre-load sodium 48 hours out. Target 500–750ml/hr with electrolytes on race day. Race-day realities: High heat and humidity.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for L'Étape Tabasco by Tour de France’s 83 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Endurance, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 83 miles of flat tropical road course in Villahermosa, Tabasco, Mexico.
